key_highlights: Wall Street tech rebound spurs ASX rally despite earlier correction jitters and volatility
Domestic miners advance on exploration flow and gold support while Chinese real estate risks linger
Macro concerns escalate as domestic recession warnings clash with federal government assurances
Housing affordability pressures and credit constraints drive calls for APRA serviceability reform
Domestic gas supply shortages and data centre power demands threaten energy transition goals

sectors.trend: Miners rebound led by aggressive gold, copper, manganese, and rare earth exploration results despite Chinese property headwinds.
sectors.implications: Favours base and precious metal explorers; bulk iron ore miners remain exposed to slowing Chinese construction demand.

sectors.trend: Major banks face reputational management and scrutiny alongside growing pressure on APRA to loosen mortgage serviceability buffers.
sectors.implications: Subdued credit demand and high mortgage rates limit loan growth; buffer adjustments could offer modest volume relief.

sectors.trend: Local tech moves in lockstep with US mega-cap swings while domestic AI copyright policy secures bipartisan backing.
sectors.implications: High beta leaves valuations sensitive to global risk appetite; policy clarity supports domestic enterprise AI integration.

sectors.trend: Persistent domestic gas shortfalls coincide with surging baseload power requirements for data centres.
sectors.implications: Strengthens pricing power for domestic gas producers but threatens renewable targets and lifts industrial operating costs.

sectors.trend: Targeted oncology clinical advancements contrast with mounting intergenerational pricing friction in private health insurance.
sectors.implications: Selective upside in clinical-stage biotechs; health insurers face regulatory resistance on premium rate adjustments.

key_themes: Macroeconomic divergence between domestic recession risks and official optimism
Resource rotation: Gold, copper, and critical minerals outperforming bulk iron ore
Prudential credit constraints and structural shifts in Australian residential real estate
Grid infrastructure and energy supply constraints accelerated by AI data centre buildouts

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight pure-play bulk iron ore miners; rotate into copper, gold, and critical minerals.
Increase allocations to defensive non-cyclicals, high-grade corporate credit, and cash reserves.
Trim exposure to highly leveraged domestic banks and non-bank mortgage lenders.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Domestic Gas Supply Crunch & Grid Bottlenecks
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight unhedged domestic gas producers; hedge energy costs for energy-intensive industrials.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Gold and Critical Minerals Explorers
opportunities.rationale: High-grade exploration drill results and robust gold pricing provide strong alpha insulated from Chinese property weakness.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective Exposure to Domestic Gas & Data Infrastructure
opportunities.rationale: Structural shortages in east-coast gas and rising hyperscale data centre power demand support realised energy margins.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge Exposure to ASX Heavyweights and Iron Ore Pure-Plays
defensive_moves.rationale: Persistent downturn in Chinese real estate and local macro growth headwinds threaten index earnings momentum.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Retail Banks and Private Health Insurers
defensive_moves.rationale: Tighter net interest margins, APRA serviceability constraints, and demographic margin pressures curb earnings visibility.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading as US tech volatility, cautious consumer sentiment, and RBA policy uncertainty cap near-term upside.
market_outlook.long_term: Divergence across sectors with materials leadership pivoting from iron ore to energy transition metals, while banking faces muted credit expansion.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and monetary policy commentary
Chinese monthly property investment and steel output indicators
Australian quarterly GDP and household spending figures
Domestic gas supply commitments and energy market regulatory announcements
watch_list: Iron ore 62% Fe CFR Qingdao spot price
East-coast wholesale gas and electricity spot tariffs
